previous_versions.body: I think there ought to be some way for users of the ASVS to easily identify the meaning behind relevant terminology used in each chapter without reading the glossary from top to bottom (or somehow knowing when a specific term has a corresponding definition they can search for), but perhaps that is not shared.

I think there ought to be some way for users of the ASVS to easily identify the meaning behind relevant terminology used in each chapter without reading the glossary from top to bottom, but perhaps that is not shared.

> I think there ought to be some way for users of the ASVS to easily identify the meaning behind relevant terminology used in each chapter without reading the glossary from top to bottom (or somehow knowing when a specific term has a corresponding definition they can search for), but perhaps that is not shared.

So I think having a glossary that is not ordered alphabetically would be a little tricky. Obviously the glossary can also be searched. I am however open to suggestions in what we could.

One option is to have multiple copies of the glossary which are ordered differently and generated using a script. We would still need a clear definition of the different orders though.

What do you think @ryarmst ?
